rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for the insect.

example.english: That butterfly flew into the house.
example.jyutping: go2 zek3 wu4 dip6 fei1 zo2 jap6 uk1 wo3

rows.note: Use this specifically for the butterfly stroke in swimming.

example.english: I can swim the butterfly stroke pretty fast.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dip6 sik1 jau4 dak1 gei2 faai3 gaa3

rows.note: Use this for the small adhesive strips used to hold an open wound closed.

example.english: The nurse put a butterfly bandage over my open wound.
example.traditional: 傷口裂開咗，姑娘幫我貼咗塊蝴蝶膠布。
example.jyutping: soeng1 hau2 lit6 hoi1 zo2 gu1 noeng4 bong1 ngo5 tip3 zo2 faai3 wu4 dip6 gaau1 bou3
